mainEntity.name: How long does a typical outdoor sink installation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an outdoor sink installation project typically ranges from one to three days, depending on the complexity of plumbing and drainage requirements. Factors like the distance to existing water lines, the need for new trenching, and the type of sink chosen can influence the timeline. Our team works efficiently to minimize disruption, and we'll provide a detailed project schedule after an initial site assessment. Unexpected site conditions, such as encountering rock during excavation, could extend the timeline.
